intro: Converting square meters (m²) to square feet (ft²) is essential when translating measurements across real estate land deeds, agricultural plot surveying, flooring estimation, and architectural floor plans. One square meter equals 10.76391 square feet, while one square foot equals 0.0929 square meters. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many square feet are in 1 square meter?
faqs.answer: There are 10.76391 square feet (ft²) in 1 square meter (m²). To convert m² to ft², use the exact conversion factor 10.76391.

faqs.question: How do I convert square meters to square feet manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your square meter value by 10.76391 (exact factor: 10.76391). For example, 100 m² × 10.76391 = 1,076.39104 ft².
